evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-attempt timestamps joining signal, quote, simulation, submission, signature, receipt or Solana landing state, and exit.
Money-weighted realised NET P&L by strategy and chain after DEX fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, builder tips, platform fees, failed-attempt costs and non-refundable rent.
Separate STRATEGY/MARKET loss and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure classifications with reason codes and final transaction resolution.
Quote-to-fill and simulation-to-fill deterioration distributions by trade size, route, venue, liquidity and congestion regime.
Solana compute-unit, priority-fee, account-creation/rent, blockhash-expiry, RPC and landing-failure observations.
EVM revert, dropped/replaced transaction, nonce, timeout, receipt, effective-gas and fee-settlement cost observations.
Out-of-sample shadow cohorts including negative outcomes rather than positive-only route samples.

Before any promotion: at least 30 completed all-in-cost shadow round trips per chain, three independent market windows, positive money-weighted net P&L, profit factor above the approved threshold, a positive conservative confidence bound, acceptable drawdown, and complete cost/failure reconciliation.

Before CANARY or LIVE consideration: independent execution validation at intended size, stable failure rates, resolved accounting, sellability and liquidity evidence, and explicit human approval through existing governance.

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter evidence requirements will delay decisions and may leave strategies in shadow longer.

evidence.detail: record_window accepts an explicit net_profit value without checking that it equals gross_profit minus gross_loss, fees, slippage and other costs.
evaluate_strategy can assign PROMOTION_CANDIDATE from aggregate net and profit factor while execution_failures are reported but do not gate or classify promotion.

proposals.expected_effect: More reliable shadow ranking and promotion decisions based on reconciled economic outcomes, with explicit STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS and EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE attribution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 completed shadow round trips per chain, 3 independent market windows, and 100% cost reconciliation and failure classification.
proposals.rationale: A durable money-weighted decision requires independently reconcilable all-in net returns. Strategy or market losses must be recorded separately from failed simulation, RPC, signing, landing, revert, timeout and accounting failures; otherwise infrastructure defects can incorrectly retire a sound hypothesis or omitted costs can promote a weak one.
proposals.shadow_test: For each chain and strategy, replay at least three independent windows using immutable per-attempt records. Recompute net as proceeds minus acquisition cost, DEX fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, rent where non-refundable, platform fees and failed-attempt costs. Stop and mark the dataset invalid if aggregate recomputed net differs from stored net beyond rounding tolerance or if any failed attempt lacks an attribution class.

proposals.downside_risk: Dynamic reserves may reject more apparent opportunities and require additional quote/simulation telemetry.

evidence.detail: Shadow accounting defaults estimated_entry_fee_sol and estimated_exit_fee_sol to fixed 0.00002 SOL values.
_validate_shadow_entry uses Jupiter forward and reverse quotes for round-trip loss and entry deterioration, while evaluate_position subtracts only the configured static exit fee.

proposals.expected_effect: Solana shadow P&L that better represents executable net returns across congestion and liquidity regimes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 eligible signals, 30 completed shadow exits, coverage of three congestion bands and two liquidity bands, with no missing cost components.
proposals.rationale: Solana priority fees, route price impact, account creation/rent effects, quote expiry and landing failures vary by transaction and congestion. Static fees can overstate executable edge, particularly for small allocations. Quote-derived strategy loss must remain distinct from transaction construction, simulation, RPC, blockhash and landing failures.
proposals.shadow_test: Shadow each eligible signal with timestamped forward and unwind quotes, quoted price impact, simulated compute units, contemporaneous priority-fee estimate, account/rent delta and an expiry/landing model. Compare static-cost and dynamic all-in P&L. Fail the hypothesis if dynamic net is non-positive, if quote-to-simulated-output deterioration exceeds the configured reserve, or if execution/infrastructure failure rate exceeds 5%.

proposals.downside_risk: Attempt-level accounting is more complex, especially when timed-out broadcasts later confirm.

evidence.detail: simulate_cycle and simulate_v3_cycle reserve estimated gas and enforce minimum output; execution repeats a final exact-transaction eth_call before signing.
Receipt-confirmed realised P&L subtracts cycle gas, but profit-share settlement is a separate transaction and its gas is not included in realised_net_base.
Broadcast timeouts, reverted transactions and pre-broadcast exceptions are collapsed into REJECTED rows, limiting separation of strategy/market loss from execution/infrastructure failure.

proposals.expected_effect: More accurate EVM retained-net measurement and clearer route, RPC and transaction reliability diagnostics.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 shadow opportunities across V2 and V3, 30 receipt-resolved historical or future observations, and final-state resolution for at least 99% of submitted attempts.
proposals.rationale: The atomic route protects cycle output, but durable user net must include all economically attributable transactions and failed-attempt gas. Ambiguous failure states also prevent diagnosing whether lost edge came from market movement or infrastructure.
proposals.shadow_test: Without broadcasting, join quote, gas estimate, preflight and hypothetical settlement costs into an attempt ledger; reconcile against historical confirmed receipts when fresh evidence becomes available. Classify quote deterioration/non-positive edge as STRATEGY_MARKET and RPC, nonce, simulation, revert, timeout or dropped transaction as EXECUTION_INFRA. Stop if any broadcast-capable attempt cannot be resolved to a final state or if all-in retained net falls below the configured minimum.

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse negative attribution or regime changes may suppress routes that later improve.

evidence.detail: learn_patterns calculates avg_net_base using only positive proven observations and assigns SHADOW_CANDIDATE status without requiring money-weighted net profitability for the complete route sample.
Historical route fingerprints are selected from proof_quality PROVEN_WRAPPED_BASE rows with net_base greater than zero, excluding negative outcomes for the same route.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduced survivor bias and fewer low-quality route simulations while preserving the rule that no trade is forced without positive current edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 complete observations per route family, including at least 10 out-of-sample observations and all failed-attempt costs.
proposals.rationale: Positive-only historical selection can make unstable or losing route families look repeatable. Fresh executable quoting remains necessary, but candidate prioritisation should use all comparable positive and negative outcomes plus failure costs.
proposals.shadow_test: Build matched route cohorts using all proven outcomes, including losses and execution costs, segmented by chain, venue, size and market regime. Compare positive-only ranking with all-outcome out-of-sample ranking. Reject the learned-route hypothesis if the all-outcome cohort has non-positive net, profit factor at or below 1, or its lower-confidence net estimate is non-positive after current executable costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote strategies because they exceed a win-rate threshold.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not the objective and can conceal a negative money-weighted result.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower liquidity, sellability, simulation or minimum-edge gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades without positive executable edge would increase adverse selection and execution losses.

rejected_ideas.idea: Declare either chain profitable or canary-ready from repository architecture.
rejected_ideas.reason: The evidence package explicitly reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and contains no fresh realised outcomes.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. EVM cyclic execution has useful fail-closed quoting, gas estimation, atomic minimum-output protection and final eth_call simulation. Solana shadow copying checks quote round trips and entry deterioration. However, promotion accounting can accept caller-supplied net P&L without reconciling costs, does not adequately separate strategy/market losses from execution/infrastructure failures, and Solana shadow costs rely on static fee assumptions. Learned-route discovery also selects only historically positive observations, creating survivor bias. No profitability, canary-readiness or live-readiness conclusion is permitted without fresh runtime forensics.
